$comment: A measurement and test world (owner, 2026-11-24: "I've been building dams, and then blowing them up with yellow dynamite, and the water rushes out. Very cool but so incredibly laggy ... Imagine a 20m high dam. And 12 dynamite."; WORK_QUEUE): dam_break's valley cut 22 m into the flat world's ground (its land at 576 m, the 0.76 ground), a 20-block stone dam across it 100 m down, 4 m thick, the lake a metre under its top, held still from the start, the water at the world's own speed ("game"); at 3 s twelve yellow dynamite in the dam's downstream face, six across at 12 m and six at 17 m over the floor, lit at once (a surface-grid water runs under no bridge, so the dam's top must go). Built by dwell-sim scene.rs; `cargo test --release -p dwell-sim --test scenes measure_a -- --ignored --nocapture` measures it natively, the bench's `dam-blast` in the browser.
name: dam_blast
description: A 20-block dam blown open by 12 yellow dynamite at 3 s.
